subject.title: [Bug]: mimo-v2.5 / mimo-v2.5-pro thinking content leaked into text reply causing severe repetition

question: Should this public MiMo hidden-reasoning exposure be repaired as a normal provider bug in the Xiaomi/MiMo stream wrapper, or routed through a security/private review path before implementation?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the symptom exposes hidden reasoning to end users and a prior fix attempt was explicitly closed pending owner/security review and live proof.

options.title: Approve provider-owned repair
options.body: Treat this as a public P1 Xiaomi provider bug, keep the fix out of broad SDK/core surfaces where possible, and require targeted tests plus redacted live MiMo proof before merge.

options.title: Route through security review
options.body: Pause implementation until the security owner decides whether hidden-reasoning exposure needs private handling or additional disclosure controls.

options.title: Wait for stronger live evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open without repair until maintainers can capture raw v2.5/v2.5-pro MiMo responses that prove the exact duplicate text shape.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-owned repair
recommendation.body: Treat this as a public P1 Xiaomi provider bug, keep the fix out of broad SDK/core surfaces where possible, and require targeted tests plus redacted live MiMo proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They already made the visible owner/security routing call on the related dedup PR and kept this issue open for that decision.
